content: Samar Ghosh follows up with insurance agent Neha Kapoor regarding his health policy renewal and concerns over the premium increase. Neha offers an additional 2% discount (bringing the total to 7%), which is her maximum, and reminds Samar that his policy has already expired and he will lose coverage if he does not renew.

action_items: Decide whether to renew the health policy with the new 7% total discount
